meta.energiebesparingsplicht.html.title: Energy saving obligation for hotels · Lemnion
meta.energiebesparingsplicht.html.descri: Hotels with high energy use must take energy-saving measures and report on them every 4 years. Check whether your hotel is in scope and what you need to do.
besparing.sub: Hotels with high energy use must take energy-saving measures and report on them periodically to the government. We explain when this applies to your hotel, what you need to do and when the next reporting round is coming.
besparing.wat-h2: The obligation to save and to report
besparing.wat-p: The energy saving obligation requires sites with high energy use to implement all recognised energy-saving measures with a payback period of 5 years or less. In addition, the information obligation applies: every 4 years you report which measures you have taken. Since 1 January 2024 the obligation is embedded in the Environment and Planning Act (Bbl and Bal) and reporting runs through RVO.
besparing.geldt-lead: The obligation applies per site based on annual energy use.
besparing.g1p: A site counts if it uses 50,000 kWh of electricity or more per year, or 25,000 m3 of natural gas (or equivalent) or more.
besparing.g2p: The threshold applies per site, not to your whole chain. Different sites of one hotel group are therefore assessed separately.
besparing.g3p: Hotels are non-residential buildings and sites; virtually all hotels sit above the threshold. The owner is responsible for the building-related parts, the operator for the activity-related parts.
besparing.d1p: Implement all recognised energy-saving measures with a payback period of 5 years or less, according to the Recognised Measures List (EML).
besparing.d2p: Report periodically which measures you have taken. The first round was at the end of 2023; the next reporting round falls around 1 December 2027.
besparing.d3p: You file the report digitally via eHerkenning (level 2 or higher). The environmental service enforces the obligation.
besparing.waarom-h2: The report is a trigger to electrify
besparing.waarom-p: The 4-yearly report and the replacement moments of boilers and burners are natural moments to electrify step by step and reduce your energy use. We help you plan measures and investments so they count in your report and lower your energy costs.
besparing.ctah: Want to know whether your hotel meets the obligation?
besparing.ctap: In a short conversation we map your energy use and the recognised measures and include them in your sustainability approach. No strings attached.
